run_fastRNN_generation: run the fastRNN generator CLI to generate text from prompts using a consolidated model checkpoint
load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer: load a consolidated fastRNN model and tokenizer from a checkpoint path for minGRU, minLSTM, or hawk model types
create_PackedRNNGenerator: create a PackedRNNGenerator instance with config args, a model, and a tokenizer for packed sequence generation
use_StateCache: use the StateCache module to manage convolution and state cache buffers for GRU, LSTM, or RGLRU RNN layers
run_PackedRNNGenerator_generate: run the PackedRNNGenerator generate method to produce text from a list of prompts with token-level sampling
